fields.sharpe: mean excess return over T-bills / volatility
fields.max_dd: worst fall from a previous high
fields.funding_share: funding received per year as a share of the NAV of the day (each day's flow / previous NAV, summed, / years)
fields.fees_share: taker and spot fees plus the maintenance remnants kept at liquidations, same units
fields.short_pnl_share: perpetual P&L before funding and fees, same units
fields.liq_cost: CAGR with liquidations switched off (unlimited top-up, not tradable) minus the CAGR as modelled; null where not computed
fields.mix_share: QQQ share of the QQQ / T-bill mix with the same volatility, rebalanced daily
